description: Style-aligned optional motion guidance; not a requirement to install Anime.js. Durations are design starting points, not guaranteed runtime values.

reduced_motion.rule: Honor @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). When active, set duration_ms to 0 and disable all non-essential transforms and translations.

claymorphism.interaction: Pressed button with 1–2% compression and a brief return; keep existing sculpted shading.

frutiger-aero.interaction: Buoyant, tactile press with 120ms ease-out compression (translateY 1.5px) and specular highlight contraction; subtle upward dock float on hover.
frutiger-aero.avoid: continuous floating bubble loops, spinning widgets, and delayed bouncy springs

brutalism.interaction: Use immediate state flips by default (0ms) for Raw Brutalism; for Brutalist Bento modular tiles, use immediate or brief restrained transitions (0–100ms) that preserve structural stability.
brutalism.avoid: springs, sliding reveals, theatrical scroll animations, continuous tile bounce

neo-brutalism.interaction: Short direct 1–2px button shift with a matching hard-shadow response; never animate giant shadows.

minimalism.interaction: Short opacity or translation feedback only on a meaningful state change; zero distracting animation during repeated data work.
minimalism.avoid: reveal-everything choreography, staggering tables, and moving metrics

swiss-editorial.interaction: Precise, restrained underlines or sectional changes that preserve reading flow.
swiss-editorial.avoid: word-by-word autoplay and gratuitous kinetic text

retro-terminal.interaction: Immediate state changes; optional skippable typing demo only when user asks.
retro-terminal.avoid: typing essential instructions and never-ending blinking gimmicks

retro-pixel.interaction: Short stepped button press (2px displacement) and crisp window toggle; no bouncy springs or continuous glitch loops.
retro-pixel.avoid: bounce, overshoot, continuous glitch animations, CRT distortion loops

art-deco.interaction: Subtle hover feedback, short opacity transitions, and restrained state transitions for geometric frames and controls; preserve architectural stability.
art-deco.avoid: constantly animated ornaments, excessive parallax, aggressive scroll effects, bounce and elastic transitions

y2k-futurism.interaction: Precise downward button displacement (1.5px) with immediate specular shadow response; subtle metallic border glint without distracting bounce.
y2k-futurism.avoid: floating 3D globes, spinning ASCII skulls, heavy bounce, and endless glitch loops
